item.description:
OpenDuckFrame 0.3.3

  • Frame generation now uses ODF-VFI, a four-stage model derived from RIFE 4.25, as its default model.
  • Reduced model processing overhead while retaining continuous caching and the existing Air window optimizations.
  • Window optimization uses bounded feedback during startup calibration, retaining the same final timing limits when GPU costs shift during warmup.
  • Existing enhancement profiles remain compatible. Scaling and super-resolution settings are unchanged.

ODF-VFI is a structural reduction of the upstream model, not a lossless-quality guarantee. Results depend on the source content.

This community build is ad-hoc signed and supports signed in-app updates. It is not Apple notarized.

OpenDuckFrame 0.3.2

  • 重新设计画质工作台，采用顶部导航、大预览区和右侧紧凑控制栏，关闭功能后自动收起参数。
  • 帧生成统一使用 RIFE 4.25，连续缓存默认开启，窗口增强自动跟随来源。
  • 完善配置管理与中英文、深浅色显示，修复倒计时取消、显示器输出修改和窗口放大、全屏布局。
  • 视频文件的帧生成设置统一进入画质工作台。

本轮验证覆盖界面与交互、配置与按钮状态回归、Release 构建及应用包验证。

English

A compact workbench with toolbar navigation, a larger preview and a right-hand control panel. Disabled features collapse their settings. Frame generation uses RIFE 4.25 with stream caching enabled by default. Window enhancement follows its source. This release improves configuration management, countdown cancellation, output-setting changes, localization, appearance and window/full-screen layout. File frame-generation settings open in the workbench.

Requires Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later. This ad-hoc signed community build supports signed in-app updates and is not Apple notarized.

OpenDuckFrame 0.3.1

  • 现有 RIFE 4.25、Fast、2 倍补帧配置接入 M3 MacBook Air 的窗口优化。连续缓存开启、关闭超分时自动匹配，无需新增模式开关。
  • 融合画面转换和缩放、复用 GPU 纹理，并优化源帧间隔估计与呈现时机。插入帧按自适应较低尺寸计算后放大，原始帧保留采集尺寸。
  • 调整帧的交付提前量和保序显示规则，减少刷新时机抖动造成的丢帧。正常补帧时，部分画面会顺延一个刷新周期，60 Hz 下约为 16.7 毫秒。
  • 已验证普通 SDR BT.709、60 Hz 输出，窗口采集不超过 2648×1668 像素。超出该路径的格式、刷新率或尺寸时显示原因并保留原帧。
  • 保留窗口、屏幕、本地文件和画质设置入口，延迟增强默认倒计时调整为 3 秒。

English

The existing RIFE 4.25 / Fast / X2 live-window configuration now selects the optimized pipeline on M3 MacBook Air with stream caching enabled and scaling disabled. Fused conversion, GPU texture reuse and source-aware presentation timing reduce processing cost. Generated pictures use adaptive lower-resolution inference and reconstruction; original pictures retain capture resolution.

Earlier frame handoff and bounded, PTS-ordered selection reduce losses caused by presentation phase jitter. During normal interpolation, some pictures can be displayed one refresh later, approximately 16.7 milliseconds at 60 Hz.

The validated envelope is ordinary SDR BT.709 video, a 60 Hz display and capture buffers up to 2648×1668 pixels. Unsupported inputs in this optimized path pass original pictures through with a visible reason. Window, display, local-file and quality controls remain available. The delayed-enhancement countdown defaults to 3 seconds.

This community build is ad-hoc signed, supports signed in-app updates, and is not Apple notarized. Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon.
